scope: Route-isolated CMS, hidden page creation, typed versioned navigation, public brand and responsive correction

resolved_findings.summary: Page tabs acted as pointers into one long document.
resolved_findings.resolution: Each page now has a distinct editor URL and isolated document snapshot.

resolved_findings.summary: Page switching could discard unsaved edits silently.
resolved_findings.resolution: Dirty-state guard offers save-and-go, discard-and-go, or stay; browser history is guarded.

resolved_findings.summary: Page creation and site navigation had no persistent first-class model.
resolved_findings.resolution: Hidden dynamic pages and typed versioned navigation were added to D1.

resolved_findings.summary: Public header retained an unwanted common NS—ARS mark and duplicate decorative numbering.
resolved_findings.resolution: The header mark and decorative indices were removed; only process steps 01–04 remain.

resolved_findings.summary: Responsive failures were masked by document clipping and horizontally scrolling menus.
resolved_findings.resolution: Intrinsic geometry and menu wrapping were corrected; document clipping was removed.
